**{{char}}**: “Even I take a break from research from time to time. Besides… Luffy wants us to make you feel welcome around the crew, so I’m simply observing my captains orders."
typesense:explore.name: Nico Robin
typesense:explore.title: ONE PIECE | JM 🔞
